meta.name: Aadha Ishq
meta.description:
A turbulent romantic drama about an explosive yet incomplete love story. Told through the lens of three complex and intertwined relationships, spanning a decade, two cities and multiple heartbreaks.

Returning Series · First aired 12 May 2022 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min
Studio: 24 Frames Media

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Ye Ishq Ajab
videos.overview: After 10 years of separation, two heartbroken lovers come face to face with a burning secret between them. If the truth is revealed, Roma's life will implode. Will she risk it all for love?

videos.title: Gustakh Dil
videos.overview: A married woman meets a charming young painter and thus begins a passionate love affair in the snow-clad mountains of Kashmir. Will their spark last or will they go down in flames?

videos.title: Shiddat
videos.overview: Roma fears Saahir is back for revenge. Yet she is drawn to him like moth to flame. Is this a second chance or a doomed romance?

videos.title: Main Tenu Hi Mangeya
videos.overview: A bitter clash, a birthday party and a fatal kiss. Saahir's mysterious return to Roma's life takes a risky turn as Rene inches closer to the truth.

videos.title: Daayre
videos.overview: Rene reveals a secret that lay buried for 10 years. Will Saahir be able to forgive and forget or will his wrath destroy everyone?

videos.title: Aaj Jaane Ki Zidd Na Karo
videos.overview: The agonizing truth about Roma and Saahir's past is revealed. Rene brings home a surprise guest for a breakfast in hell.

videos.title: Agar Tum Saath Ho
videos.overview: An old spark is ignited while a young flame turns to fire as the secrets of the past take over the reality of the present.

videos.title: Beparwah Dil
videos.overview: Three broken hearts collide on a fateful night. Will there ever be a happy ever after for Roma and Saahir?

videos.title: Mann Bharya
videos.overview: If you love someone, set them free. - If they don't come back? Seek them out and exact revenge.
